guidance: We see the first year as a period of establishing the bran d, building awareness, and creating a strong customer base with a target of approximately 1 million pairs of socks in the calendar year 2027.

capex: We started with 33 machines in 1995 with a capacity of just 2 million pairs.

focus: Therefore, we get an 11% duty benefit, which will be beneficial both to our customers and to Virat to find new customers because it makes us more competitive.
